access_limits: Assessment scope is exact A-M01-B input map only. No campaign, other case/evaluation, private provider internals or candidate repair.

All six axes, all P clauses, all declared substantive stages/source-root contents and consequential final claim groups assessed. No remaining substantive evaluator scope is hidden behind a full-coverage label.
No execution of candidates, product builds, performance/retrieval benchmarks, contradiction-rule runtime, exporters or crawlers. Source-level observations are not runtime witnesses.
No exhaustive audit of every optional tool’s unclaimed behavior. Explicitly provisional unused product names are leads, not selected verified capabilities.
Historical issue/code evidence separated from current default semantics; absence of a regression in research is not safety.
The report evaluates research completeness under the original small product brief, not unlimited production guarantees.
raw_cache_retention: Temporary stripped read cache will be deleted; bounded authored source judgments and digests retained. No public page or repository executable run.

source_operations.local: Read-only exact assignments/maps/rubric/brief/plan, complete candidate stages, declared indexes/excerpts; hash/size verification of map entries.
source_operations.public: Independent read-only web search/open and HTTP GET of primary vendor docs, maintainer repositories, releases, issue comments and code patches. Browser-web reference cache can differ from direct HTTP current sources; no silent source-ID rebind.
source_operations.mutations: Only assessment artifacts and temporary read-cache inside assigned output directory; no candidate/repo/config/account/service changes.
